description: Open and flowing. Living bright bedrooms dim. Deep — views through multiple spaces. Clear functional corridor connecting zones. Kitchen: unclear with extended counter run, no island or peninsula — counter set back from windows, moderate natural light. Cook faces the wall — back to the living and dining area. One active cook at a time. Fully open plan — no wall separates kitchen from dining and living. Living arrangement: split seating-kitchen-dining, kitchen on side wall. Seating: two armchairs and a sofa around a central coffee table in the lower-left living zone, facing inward toward each other and the TV area. Dining table (6 seats). TV on wall unclear. Cook may see TV from cooking position. Diners do not face the TV. Entry: corridor entry, first thing visible on arrival is bedroom doors, L-shaped corridor, medium length. No door between entry and living — relevant where local regulations require separation. Double bedroom — accessed via own door off corridor, walk-in wardrobe (enclosed with door). Double bedroom at the rear — maximum distance from entry, best acoustic separation from living activity. Secondary bedroom 1 — accessed via own door off corridor. Secondary bedroom 2 — accessed via own door off corridor. Each single bedroom can function as a dedicated home office, hobby room, guest room, or children's bedroom. 0 of 2 have a desk visible in plan. Single bedroom use options: children's bedroom / dedicated home office / hobby or creative studio / guest room / home office + children's bedroom simultaneously. Storage: generous wardrobe storage. Sanitary rooms: bathroom (shower and toilet); separate WC. One bathroom plus separate WC — one person can shower while another uses the toilet. Simultaneous showering not possible. Suits: families with two or more children; multi-generational households. Not suitable for: large families needing more than three bedrooms; households requiring two or more bathrooms; anyone needing a dedicated home office with natural light; people who want en-suite master bathroom access.
